title: kk7 correctness: CorsLayer::permissive() sets allow-credentials with wildcard origin (SECURITY)
description: In server.rs build_cors_layer() lines 138-141, when allowed_origins contains '*', the code returns CorsLayer::permissive(). According to tower-http 0.6 docs, permissive() enables BOTH wildcard origin AND Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true, violating the W3C CORS security invariant that forbids combining wildcard origin with credentials. This allows any malicious website to make credentialed requests on behalf of authenticated users, causing CSRF and cookie theft. Must use CorsLayer::new().allow_origin(AllowOrigin::any()) instead to get wildcard without credentials. Test at line 1002-1007 documents but does not actually verify the invariant.
